title: Finance Assistant - Purchase Ledger
description:
Finance & Purchase Ledger Assistant

Location: Huddersfield

Salary: £28,000 - £29,000 per annum
Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Start Date: Immediate Start Available

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Finance & Purchase Ledger Assistant
to join our clients established and growing team in Huddersfield.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and
detail-oriented individual looking to become a key member of a
busy finance department.

The successful candidate will have strong purchase ledger
experience, excellent attention to detail, and be confident
managing supplier accounts from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

Processing high volumes of purchase invoices accurately and
efficiently
Matching, batching and coding invoices
Reconciling supplier statements and resolving queries
Processing supplier payments and payment runs
Managing supplier account set-up and maintenance
Investigating and resolving invoice discrepancies
Assisting with month-end purchase ledger activities
Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation
Supporting the wider finance team with administrative and
accounting duties

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

Minimum 3 years' experience within a Purchase Ledger or Finance
role
Strong working knowledge of Xero

Proven experience processing and reconciling supplier payments
Experience managing supplier accounts and relationships
Excellent accuracy and attention to detail
Strong organisational and communication skills
Ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines
A positive, team-focused approach

What's On Offer?

Competitive salary of £28,000 - £29,000

Permanent, stable opportunity
Friendly and supportive working environment
Immediate start available
Opportunity to join an established and successful business

If you're an experienced Purchase Ledger professional with strong
Xero knowledge and are available to start immediately, we'd love
to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV for immediate consideration.

title: HR Coordinator / Advisor
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR Coordinator/Advisor
The OpportunityWe are looking for an experienced HR Coordinator / Advisor to join a busy and collaborative HR team. This is a varied, hands-on role that offers exposure across the full employee lifecycle, combining day-to-day HR operations, employee relations support, HR administration, systems management and continuous improvement projects.
This opportunity would suit someone who enjoys delivering high-quality HR support, takes pride in providing excellent service to managers and employees, and is equally comfortable managing detailed administration as they are contributing to wider HR initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
As part of the HR team, you will:
- Provide practical, timely advice and guidance to managers and employees on HR policies, procedures and employment law matters.
- Manage employee lifecycle administration, including contracts, offer letters, contractual changes, family leave and leaver processes.
- Take ownership of the central HR inbox, responding to and managing a wide range of HR queries from employees and managers.
- Identify recurring themes and opportunities to improve HR guidance, processes, FAQs and system automation.
- Support employee relations matters including absence management, performance issues, disciplinary matters and grievances, escalating where appropriate.
- Maintain accurate employee records and ensure HR systems and personnel files remain up to date.
- Coordinate effective onboarding and offboarding processes across multiple locations.
- Support recruitment activity, including administration of vacancies, candidate documentation and liaison with hiring managers and successful applicants.
- Work closely with payroll colleagues to ensure employee changes are processed accurately and within required timescales.
- Monitor key people processes such as probation reviews, absence management and compliance activities.
- Produce monthly HR reports and management information, using Excel to analyse and reconcile data.
- Assist with the development and review of HR policies, procedures and systems.
- Support HR projects, process improvements and broader people initiatives.
- Ensure HR activities remain compliant with employment legislation and internal policies.

About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous HR generalist experience.
- A sound understanding of UK employment law and its practical application.
- Experience advising managers and employees on day-to-day employee relations matters.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload.
- Confidence managing employee lifecycle administration and maintaining accurate records.
- Experience working with HR systems and strong IT skills, including Excel.
- The ability to manage a busy shared inbox and respond to queries with professionalism, accuracy and discretion.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong attention to detail and a customer-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently, make sound decisions and recognise when escalation is required.
- A flexible mindset and the ability to adapt in a changing environment.

A CIPD qualification, or equivalent, would be advantageous.
What's ImportantThis is a genuinely hands-on HR role. Whilst there will be opportunities to contribute to projects, process improvements and wider people initiatives, a significant part of the position is focused on delivering excellent day-to-day HR support and administration.We are looking for someone who values accuracy, takes ownership of their workload, enjoys supporting employees and managers, and is passionate about continuously improving the HR experience.If you're seeking a varied HR opportunity where you can make a real impact while developing your expertise across the full employee lifecycle, we'd love to hear from you.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Jaguar Land Rover Accounts Assistant
description:
About the role

Jaguar Land Rover Huddersfield has a fantastic opportunity available for an Accounts Assistant to join their team.

As a Sytner Accounts Assistant, you will support the day to day functions of the accounts department from the sales and purchase ledgers to the daily cash postings and bank reconciliations. You will also assist the Dealership Accountant and Management team in other ad-hoc duties where required.

Sytner Accounts Assistants work a variety of flexible patterns between Mondays - Friday; however, this sometimes can include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About You

Previous experience and a good working knowledge of all accounting routines, including stock checks and month-end reconciliations are essential. Knowledge of the CDK/Kerridge Dealer Management system and Microsoft Office would is not essential but would be advantageous.

Ideally, you will be enthusiastic, well organised, diligent, and able to work to strict deadlines whilst paying attention to detail and working both as an individual and as part of a small team.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement - 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please .

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on 'Developing Talent and 'Building Careers' and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.
